items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: there was one Woody Allen movie where his parents come on at the very end... I think parents never let go of that somehow.

ctx.x: Did your parents become comfortable with your choice of living eventually?

Eventually they did but it took a long time I think. I don’t know if it ever really quite sunk in, you know, because they’d always say well why don’t you — can’t you go back — because I didn’t quite finish Berklee. I didn’t get the degree, the music ed degree. And they said, “Can’t you go back to Berklee and finish and get that?” And I said no, no, I’m working now. And it sort of reminds me of like, there was one Woody Allen movie where his parents come on at the very end, I forget which one it is, and they are…
You seem to have had your tastes in a lot of different places. Has it always been of your own choosing?
